data.name: Usage
data.value:
srcsharp: authoring tools for SRC# data and scenarios
Usage: srcsharp lint <directory or file>... [--format text|sarif] [--output file] Check data (*.txt) and events (*.eve). Exit code 1 if problems are found srcsharp play <event file> [--script file.play] [--out directory] [--app-path SRC folder] [--steps count] Run a scenario without a screen. Without --script, advance messages and pick the first choice srcsharp balance <directory or file>... [--format md|csv] [--output file] List unit data stats and outliers srcsharp lsp Language Server (stdio) srcsharp dap Debugger (Debug Adapter Protocol, stdio)
Common options: --lang <ja|en|zh-Hans|...|auto> Display language. Can also be set with the SRCSHARP_LANG environment variable (the option wins). Default is ja; auto follows the OS setting
